name: Methotrexate

own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for breathing problems, liver harm and blood problems

fda.text: EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY, HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS, SEVERE ADVERSE REACTIONS, and RISK OF MEDICATION ERRORS • Methotrexate tablets can cause embryo-fetal toxicity, including fetal death. For non-neoplastic diseases, methotrexate tablets are contraindicated in pregnancy. For neoplastic diseases, advise females and males…

summary: Methotrexate has a boxed warning, which is the strongest safety alert from the FDA, regarding breathing problems, liver harm, blood problems, severe allergic-like reactions, medication errors, and harm or death to an unborn baby [3][4]. The drug's warnings also highlight risks of serious infections and damage to the nervous system [4]. Additionally, a small computer model—not tests done on people—gave it a high score of 72 for liver risk and a low score of 28 for heart risk [M].
